title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Semi-led massive tech rally. QQQ surged 3.30% and SOXX exploded 8.50%, crushing defensives as money rotated aggressively into AI/semiconductors on renewed AI capex optimism, with Fed hike odds at 62.4% failing to dent risk appetite.

INDICES — VIX 17.1, down 6.48%. Rank best to worst: SOXX +8.50%, QQQ +3.30%, SPY +1.68%, IWM +1.39%, DIA +1.18%. Large > small by 1.91pp (QQQ vs IWM). Dollar fell 0.99%, gold +1.64%, oil -1.42%. SPY and QQQ both above 200-day MA — no CTA sell trigger.

VOLUME — SPY vol_ratio 1.1x, QQQ 1.8x — QQQ volume surging with price up = clear accumulation. SOXX 1.7x also accumulation. DIA 0.9x and IJR 0.8x declining volume showing low conviction in value/small caps.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLK Technology +5.50%, XLI Industrials +0.98%, XLY Discretionary +0.70%, XLF Financials +0.56%, XLE Energy +0.53%, XLB Materials -0.19%, XLU Utilities -0.56%, XLRE Real Estate -1.44%, XLV Healthcare -1.64%, XLP Staples -2.16%, XLC Comms -2.68%. Top Industries: WGMI +22.10% (crypto mining), DRAM +16.70%; Bottom: USO -1.42% (oil), SCHH -1.45% (housing). Money flooding into semiconductors and AI infrastructure, fleeing staples, healthcare, and comms. Rotation state: AI hardware leading.

POSITIONING — SPY put-call ratio 1.23, elevated protection demand; QQQ 1.32 also high. IV skew +10.9% for both — put premium elevated, fear present. SPY spot ~740 vs GEX flip 750 — below gamma flip, amplifying downside if selling resumes. VIX 17.1 at 20-day MA — no complacency.

CROSS-ASSET — Dollar -0.99% vs gold +1.64% and silver +3.34% — classic dollar weakness boosting precious metals. Oil -1.42% despite dollar drop, signaling demand fears as rate hike odds rise.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 60.5 Greed. Top movers: MSFT +15.51% (Mag 7), HII +14.09% (Defense), PWR +17.26% (Buildout). Best 20d momentum: XLE Energy +11.65% despite today's fade; worst: SOXX -15.87% but today's massive bounce. Vol spikes: MSFT 3.6x with price up = accumulation. News: Microsoft options activity and analyst hikes drove the mega-cap AI rally. Watch: PWR +17.26% on 3.0x vol — trend divergence from broader industrials; MSFT +15.51% — momentum break after deep selloff; LHX -8.61% on 3.6x vol — distribution in defense.
